scenarios.name: Byzantine Double-Propose Attack
scenarios.description: Conflicting block proposals for the same height/round are flagged as equivocation and rejected by consensus engine.

scenarios.name: Byzantine Equivocation Votes Rejection
scenarios.description: Validator attempting to broadcast multiple votes with different block hashes in the same round is rejected.

scenarios.name: Non-Contiguous Block Proposal Rejection
scenarios.description: Blocks that do not sequentially extend chain tip (Height != Current + 1) are strictly rejected.

scenarios.name: Invalid AppHash Proposal Rejection
scenarios.description: Proposals containing mismatched or forged AppHash fail verification during state transition calculation.

scenarios.name: Block Header Timestamp Manipulation Rejection
scenarios.description: Block timestamps must be strictly monotonic and within acceptable BFT drift window.

scenarios.name: Byzantine Sybil Peer Rejection
scenarios.description: Commit certificates signed by unknown or sybil public keys not in genesis validator set are rejected.

scenarios.name: Commit Certificate Quorum & Cryptographic Authenticity
scenarios.description: Commit certificates strictly require >2/3 total voting power with cryptographically valid Ed25519 signatures.
